biotools.summary: Allos is a Python framework designed for high-resolution analysis of transcript diversity in single-cell and spatial transcriptomics. It enables isoform-resolved analysis, supporting both long- and short-read data, and integrating into established gene-level workflows.
biotools.name: Allos: Isoform-level Single-Cell and Spatial Transcriptomics Toolkit
